sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Checkpoint 1: Given 500 Terabytes, S3 Standard capacity at 0.023 dollars per gigabyte-month with free retrievals, and Glacier at 0.0036 dollars capacity with 0.030 dollars retrieval fee per gigabyte, calculate monthly savings, single scan cost, and break-even frequency f-star. Select Option A, B, or C above me!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Checkpoint 1! Calculate 500,000 gigabytes times 0.0194 dollars savings, multiply by 3 cents for a single scan, and divide savings by scan cost to find f-star! Choose Option A, B, or C above me!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Spot on! Moving 500 Terabytes to Glacier saves $9,700 in monthly capacity, while a single full scan costs $15,000. Dividing $9,700 by $15,000 yields f-star equal to 0.6467 scans per month, or 7.76 scans per year. If scanned 7 or fewer times per year Glacier saves money; at 8 or more scans, S3 Standard is cheaper!

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Not quite! Remember that 500,000 gigabytes times the 0.0194 rate difference yields $9,700 monthly savings, while a single scan at 3 cents per gigabyte costs $15,000. Dividing $9,700 by $15,000 gives 0.6467 scans per month, or roughly 7.76 scans per year!

sentences.text: Masterclass verified! Duke failed due to an Excel one-row shift, 50 percent inverted drug sensitivity labels, and a complete absence of version control. The HUGO committee renamed 27 human genes like SEPT2 to SEPTIN2 because spreadsheet applications lacked a global auto-formatting disable switch, corrupting over 20 percent of published papers. Production MLOps prevents this by mandating typed binary Parquet formats and automated Continuous Data Testing!

In production, we mandate typed Parquet files and automated CDT schema gates to prevent silent corruption!
